# Knowledge map: CXD90045 multi-device platform

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/platform-multidevice.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** Thirteen official updaters, nine kernels, command tables, IPC and call graphs, update-chain integrity, firmware signatures, additional bodies (ILCE-7RM4A) and the project checkpoint inventory.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-22.
- **Deep review:** 0 of 20 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Entities

### <a id="platform-bodies"></a>CXD90045 bodies and kernels

`platform.bodies` | process

Thirteen official updaters, one SoC family, nine kernels; the TargetProfile registry in src/a6400/targets/ holds ilce_6400, ilce_6400a, zv_e10, ilce_6100, ilce_6600, ilce_7c, ilce_7m3, ilce_7rm4a.

Aliases: `13 updaters`, `9 kernels`, `TargetProfile`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` Thirteen official updaters map to nine kernels; ILCE-6400 and ILCE-6600 share one kernel source (all 14,401 function symbols at the same address), ZV-E10 and ILCE-7C are one build; ten bodies gained evidence-backed kernel symbols offline. ([E0477](../evidence/0477-bionz-x-platform-map-13-updaters.md), [E0480](../evidence/0480-ten-bodies-gain-kernel-symbols-offline.md), [platform](../evidence/cross_model/platform.tsv))
- **C04** `OFFLINE` The UVC delta between bodies is a module-package delta, not a kernel-capability delta. ([E0479](../evidence/0479-uvc-is-a-module-package-delta.md), [uvc-modules](../evidence/cross_model/uvc-modules.tsv))
- **C05** `OFFLINE` Published firmware changelogs give a target for every binary diff; three declared stubs (ILCE-6100A, ILCE-6600, ILCE-7M3) gained sourced values, and ILCE-7RM4A gained a sourced reference profile. ([E0481](../evidence/0481-published-changelogs-as-diff-targets.md), [E0482](../evidence/0482-three-stubs-gain-sourced-values.md), [E0570](../evidence/0570-ilce-7rm4a-offline-sourced-profile.md), [patch-notes](../evidence/cross_model/patch-notes.json))
- **C08** `OFFLINE` Six mount points are writable at runtime and three flash partitions are frozen. ([E0486](../evidence/0486-writable-mounts-versus-the-flash-boundary.md))
- **C11** `OFFLINE` The platform model states its boundary: everything is offline from packaged images, and facts that need a camera stay unknown. ([E0490](../evidence/0490-platform-model-and-flash-boundary.md))
- **C13** `OFFLINE` A research checkpoint and publication audit inventoried local evidence at E0110. ([E0110](../evidence/0110-research-checkpoint-and-github-publication.md), [0110-local-evidence-inventory](../evidence/manifests/0110-local-evidence-inventory.json))

### <a id="platform-command-table"></a>Command tables and the 0x413b Movie Eye AF value

`platform.command-table` | process

Per-body command tables (285 records on the a6400, 286 on the a6600 with 0x413b added, 337 on ZV-E10/a7C) and a predictive command-id rule.

Current knowledge:

- **C02** `OFFLINE` The 0x413b (Movie Eye AF) value is stored and never read on every body that has it. ([E0478](../evidence/0478-movie-eye-af-stored-never-read-platform-wide.md))
- **C03** `OFFLINE` A command-id rule fitted on four bodies predicts held-out bodies (recall 0.997 ILCE-6600, 0.885 ILCE-7M3, 0.973 ILCE-9M2); no rule exists for USB IDs or device nodes. ([E0485](../evidence/0485-command-table-predicts-held-out-body.md), [prediction-scores](../evidence/cross_model/prediction-scores.tsv))

### <a id="platform-ipc-graph"></a>libObj IPC edges and call graph

`platform.ipc-graph` | process | inventory `firmware.elf:nflasha15_unpacked/lib/libObj.so`

Direct IPC call sites (osal_snd_msg, osal_snd_sync_msg, osal_rcv_msg_tmo, ioctl) and the attributed call graph of libObj.so.

Current knowledge:

- **C06** `OFFLINE` libObj.so has 763 direct IPC call sites (osal_snd_msg 187, osal_snd_sync_msg 406, osal_rcv_msg_tmo 114, ioctl 56), 544 with a constant argument, and 538,081 direct calls of which 2,785 are named at both ends. ([E0663](../evidence/0663-callgraph-plt-correction-and-real-ipc-table.md), [ipc-edges-a6400-e0663](../evidence/cross_model/ipc-edges-a6400-e0663.tsv))
- **C07** `OFFLINE` ObjDisplay_Create/Destroy/RegisterCommand/UnregisterCommand have zero direct callers and appear once each as data (stored function pointers); ObjDisplay_Start does not exist. No packaged body registers a framebuffer node; the display is dmpgles2. ([E0484](../evidence/0484-display-entry-points-are-indirect.md), [E0488](../evidence/0488-no-framebuffer-node-on-any-body.md))

Do not rely on:

- ~~libObj.so has 29 IPC call sites, 17 with a constant argument, and the earlier E0484 call-graph figures.~~ **R01** `RETRACTED` ([E0483](../evidence/0483-ipc-edge-inventory-libobj.md)); see C06: libObj.so has 763 direct IPC call sites (osal_snd_msg 187, osal_snd_sync_msg 406, osal_rcv_msg_tmo 114, ioctl 56), 544 with a constant argument, and 538,081 direct calls of which 2,785 are named at both ends. *Note: E0663: the 29 'IPC call sites' were calls to other imports, mislabelled by a fixed-stride PLT map.*

### <a id="platform-update-chain"></a>Update chain integrity and firmware signature

`platform.update-chain` | process | inventory `firmware.elf:nflasha15_unpacked/lib/libupdatertalk.so`

Packaged-file integrity (CRC32, MD5), the libupdatertalk AES (key = first 16 bytes of sha256(''), ECB) and the camera-side sauu RSA-2048/SHA-256 FDAT signature check.

Aliases: `sauu`, `FDAT`, `VerificationKey.pem`, `libupdatertalk`

Current knowledge:

- **C09** `OFFLINE` Packaged files are not protected by a per-model cipher: 484 ELF objects are readable, integrity is CRC32 and MD5, and the only AES (libupdatertalk) uses the first 16 bytes of sha256('') in ECB on all thirteen bodies. ([E0489](../evidence/0489-update-chain-integrity-is-crc32-and-md5.md), [aes-key-blocks](../evidence/cross_model/aes-key-blocks.tsv))
- **C10** `PHYSICAL` A stock camera rejects custom firmware: sauu verifies an RSA-2048/SHA-256 signature over the FDAT ciphertext with /etc/VerificationKey.pem; with that branch neutralised (one write to nflasha1:/boot/initrd.img from outside the update path) the camera accepted an unsigned FDAT and completed the update. The stock initrd was restored. ([E0666](../evidence/0666-a6400-updater-signature-verification.md))

### <a id="platform-ilce7rm4a"></a>ILCE-7RM4A (a7R IVA) reference body

`platform.ilce7rm4a` | usb-identity

Second physically identified reference body: Mass Storage 054C:0D9D, native GetModelInfo on firmware 1.13.

Aliases: `054C:0D9D`

Current knowledge:

- **C12** `PHYSICAL` The ILCE-7RM4A GetModelInfo extcmd chain is byte-identical to the a6400A; physically, firmware 1.13 enumerates as Mass Storage 054C:0D9D and answers native GetModelInfo. ([E0645](../evidence/0645-ilce-7rm4a-getmodelinfo-extcmd-chain-identical.md), [E0646](../evidence/0646-ilce-7rm4a-physical-usb-identity-and-getmodelinfo.md))
